text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- (Russian president) Boris Yeltsin announces that Russian missiles will no longer be aimed at NATO countries
- An extra two billion pesetas puts off Ronaldo deal
- Parliament to process law on unmarried couples
EL MUNDO
- Yeltsin seals end of cold war: his missiles will no longer point at the west
- Barcelona agrees to pay Ronaldo more than 11 billion pesetas for nine seasons
DIARIO 16
- Diary of (former civil guard chief) Roldan details his story
ABC
- Russia and NATO sign end to cold war
CINCO DIAS
- Santander and BBV, first in Argentina
- Vigorous company export activity
- Split-mania stimulates stock market
EXPANSION
- Santander becomes biggest private bank in Argentina
- AT&T goes on the attack and negotiates creating the world's leading telecommunications group
- Bourse continues rise towards 600 mark
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- (Santander chairman) Botin invests 85.5 billion pesetas to be Argentina's leading bank
- Bankinter to split shares one for three
- Development ministry freezes bill to liberalise television
- Government will pay health debt with privatisation income
